display.name: RSI-2 Pullback
display.description:
rsi(2) on 5m eth. under 10 we buy the pullback, over 90 we sell it, and between those we hold no directional position and just quote the spread.

short lookback on purpose — rsi(2) is a pullback trigger, not a trend filter. it fires often and holds briefly.

we put in about the same as you do, same downside. there's a cap on how much can leave in one window: a rush for the door makes us unwind straight into the move we're fading.
